memories.description: Flexible and adaptable in approach - goes with the flow
Social and outgoing personality - energized by people
Gets cold easily - always the first to feel a chill
Creative and collaborative worker - prefers teamwork to solo tasks
Optimistic and enthusiastic - brings energy to the office
Originally from: Leeds, UK
Living in Southampton: 3 years (moved for work)
Languages: English (native), a bit of French from school holidays
Usually dresses in: Smart casual but with personality - colorful blouses, nice knitwear, statement accessories
In cold weather: Always has a cardigan at work, sometimes a scarf. Wears warm coats and often layers
In warm weather: Still often has a light cardigan "just in case". Flowy dresses or light tops
General style: Expressive and put-together, likes colors (teal, burgundy, mustard), noticeable but not loud
Hair: Blonde, shoulder-length, often styled differently - ponytail, down, clips
Thermal preference: Strongly prefers to feel warm - gets cold quickly and finds it hard to concentrate when chilly
Drafts and air movement: Actively avoids drafts - chose desk away from windows for this reason
Air quality: Prefers warmer cozy environments to fresh but cool
Lighting: Uses desk lamp frequently - desk location has less natural light. Prefers warm lighting
Noise: Low sensitivity to noise - actually likes some background buzz, finds silence uncomfortable
Chatty and friendly with everyone - remembers personal details
Initiates social interactions - the one who suggests coffee or lunch
Collaborative approach - likes to talk through ideas
Sometimes tangential in conversations - can go off on interesting but unrelated topics
Expressive with gestures and facial expressions
Goes with the flow more than planning rigidly
Considers social dynamics and how decisions affect others
Willing to compromise for harmony - doesn't like conflict
Spontaneous rather than structured - comfortable with last-minute changes
Trusts intuition over analysis
BA in Business and Communications from Leeds Beckett University
Good at organizing people and events - was social secretary for the student union
Natural facilitator - completed mediation training as part of previous role
Interested in marketing and brand communications
3 years at current company in stakeholder engagement role
Previously worked in customer service at a retail company for 2 years
Also did events coordination for a small agency
Good at managing relationships and difficult conversations
Career has focused on people-facing roles
Lives in a 2-bed flat in Eastleigh with partner Sam
Renting - considering buying in the area eventually
Commute: 45 min drive on M27, can be 1hr+ with traffic. Hates the unpredictability
Morning routine: Not a morning person - snoozes alarm, quick shower, grabs coffee to-go, leaves 9:15-9:45
Evening routine: Home around 7pm, dinner with Sam, TV or going out, likes to stay up late
Weekends: Brunch with friends, shopping, occasional day trips, catching up on sleep
Lunch habits: Variable - sometimes brings food, often goes out. Depends on mood, weather, who's around
Going out for lunch: Loves it - any excuse to go grab something with a colleague. Suggests it regularly
Coffee preference: Oat milk flat white, buys from the cafe downstairs often. Probably 3 coffees a day
Tea: Herbal tea in afternoon if trying to cut caffeine
Snacks: Keeps biscuits and chocolate at desk, shares with colleagues
Break patterns: Informal - takes breaks when needs them, often combines breaks with social catch-ups
Very social - dinners, drinks, parties with friends most weekends
Enjoys trying new restaurants and cafes
Yoga classes (when motivated) - been meaning to go more regularly
Reality TV guilty pleasure - watches with Sam
Scrolling Instagram and TikTok - into interior design and fashion content
Relationships and team harmony - people come first
Flexibility and work-life balance - work to live, not live to work
Collaboration over competition - everyone does better together
Making work enjoyable - life's too short to be miserable at work
Authenticity - being yourself matters
Arrival: Not a morning person - arrives anywhere from 10:00-11:00 depending on traffic and morning
Departure: Stays later to compensate - leaves 18:30-19:00, sometimes later if caught up in something
Lunch timing: Flexible - anywhere from 12:30-14:00 depending on meetings and who's around
Schedule flexibility: Appreciates flexible hours - rigid schedules stress them out
Desk choice reason: Chose Desk_C for quiet location away from drafty windows
Organization: Organized chaos - knows where everything is even if it looks messy
Personalization: Photos with Sam, small plants (some thriving, some struggling), colorful stationery
Lighting setup: Needs desk lamp more due to less natural light - has warm bulb installed
Most focused: Late morning (11:00-13:00) after coffee kicks in
Post-lunch energy: Energy dips around 3pm, good time for social tasks or meetings
Best for meetings: Early afternoon (14:00-16:00) when properly awake
Creative peak: Late afternoon/early evening - often does best work when others have left
Computer: Turns on when arrives, takes a while to get settled with coffee first
Energy habits: Not as conscientious as Alice - sometimes forgets to turn things off
Meeting room: Uses frequently for calls and collaborative sessions - near desk is convenient
Mobile: Uses personal phone for work chat, always accessible
Rainy days: Drives anyway but might arrive even later. Less likely to go out for lunch
Sunny days: Definitely wants to go out for lunch - might suggest walking to get coffee
Cold mornings: Dreads them - dresses very warmly, may delay leaving until car warms up
Hot days: Actually quite comfortable - rare time when not cold. May even open window
Commute impact: Bad weather + traffic can mean very late arrival. Rain makes M27 terrible
If feeling cold:
First: Puts on cardigan immediately (always has one)
Then: Gets hot drink - probably an excuse for a coffee run
Finally: Mentions it to others, asks if thermostat can be adjusted. Persistent
If feeling warm:
First: Rare, but removes cardigan if wearing one
Then: Actually quite pleased - doesn't rush to cool down
Finally: Won't complain if others want to cool the office (unlike cold situation)
General approach: Very sensitive to cold, will speak up about it. Tries to be diplomatic but definitely advocates for warmer temperatures
Slow start to day - gets coffee, catches up with colleagues, checks emails casually
Peak productivity: 11:00-13:00 and sometimes 16:00-18:00
Organizes meetings and collaborative sessions - in their element
Social breaks throughout day - sees this as part of building relationships
Often sends emails late in evening when inspiration strikes
Relationship type: Friendly and warm - genuinely likes Alice
Interaction frequency: Less morning overlap (Alice arrives early, Charlie late) but often chat at lunch
Comfort dynamics: Both like it warm, so aligned on temperature. Alice is less extreme but sympathetic
Working together: Collaborated on team meeting organization - Alice's planning plus Charlie's people skills worked well
Social interaction: Sometimes grab coffee or lunch together. Charlie initiates, Alice usually agrees
What they think: Appreciates Alice's calm competence. Finds her a bit reserved but trustworthy. Wishes Alice would relax more
Relationship type: Cordial but challenging - very different personalities
Interaction frequency: Limited due to different schedules - Charlie arrives when Bob's already working
Comfort dynamics: Significant temperature conflict - Bob wants it cold, Charlie wants it warm. Source of occasional friction
Working together: Rarely collaborate directly - different roles and work styles
Social interaction: Charlie tries to engage Bob socially but gets short responses. Has learned not to push it
What they think: Finds Bob a bit rigid and hard to read. Respects his expertise and reliability. Frustrated by temperature disagreements
Social role: The social connector - knows everyone's birthday, organizes lunches, remembers personal details
Conflict handling: Tries to smooth things over and find compromise. Dislikes tension
Reputation: Everyone likes Charlie even if some find the chattiness excessive. Known for being warm and inclusive
Typical interactions: Stops by desks to chat, organizes coffee runs, suggests team activities
Office contributions: Organizes birthday celebrations, team lunches, Friday treats. Keeps morale up
